explication: This repository is a GitOps-managed homelab Kubernetes infrastructure monorepo. The main workflow is an operator changing cluster or app resources in Git, then Flux reconciling desired state into the Biohazard cluster. The map highlights documented core capabilities and backup, networking, security, and monitoring. Only the README was available as evidence, so edges represent documented relationships; paths for less-described subsystems point to their existing directories.
